facts.fact: Starlink was approved by Côte d'Ivoire's national regulator in September 2025 (as stated in an ITWeb Africa article of 24 April 2026).
Orange Côte d'Ivoire launched its Orange Sat satellite service earlier in 2026 through a partnership with Eutelsat; the article gives no more precise date.

systems.tiers: consumer and enterprise via MTN Côte d'Ivoire (multi-year agreement signed, rollout described as planned)
2024 Bayobab (MTN) partnership; no CIV retail sale stated

note: MTN-Eutelsat Konnect deal is a signed agreement to deploy, not stated as on sale, so no fact for it.
